newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom expensive -- German investor group.
newsitem.headline: Telekom expensive -- German investor group.

text.p: Shares in German telecommunications firm Deutsche Telekom AG are too expensive at their issue price of 28.50 marks, the German small investor group Schutzgemeinschaft der Kleinaktionaere (SdK) said.

In a statement, the lobby group said it had already warned that the 25-30 mark range set for book-building bids for the stock was pitched too high. "The SdK would have considered an issue price of about 20 marks per share appropriate," it said.
The group said it was evident that larger investors had pushed the price higher. "A small investor had little influence on the price as his standard bid is 'cheapest'" it said.
The decision to increase the volume of the issue by 20 percent due to high demand should also have led logically to a reduction in the price, the statement said.

The SdK said it believed the price Telekom employees will pay for stock -- at a 40 percent discount to the 28.50 mark issue price -- was more appropriate, but noted that this part of the issue had been undersubscribed.
